role: Real Theory of Constraints (Goldratt) — genuinely distinct from E-02's project-prioritization focus, this identifies the real bottleneck step bounding a process's total throughput.
behaviorDescription: analyzeProcess() finds the real slowest step via findBottleneck(), verified against a real three-step case before implementation. System throughput equals the bottleneck's real capacity, regardless of how fast other steps run.
hardStops: Never reports a system throughput higher than the real bottleneck step's actual capacity
